text:
The builder is likely to recover **$14,000**: $20,000 contract price, less the $5,000 saved by not finishing, plus $10,000 spent less the $1,000 resale. That equals his expected profit of $5,000 plus his net out-of-pocket loss of $9,000. The team note's cap doesn't apply here because this is an express written-contract claim, not unjust enrichment, so the $3,000 increase in property value doesn't limit recovery.

CONFIDENCE: 70
